Extraction and external models remain trusted correspondence boundaries; no correctness theorem for Charon or Aeneas is claimed.
Existing generated-loop proofs use fixed supplied atomic observations, not changing concurrent Rust observations.
Actual identities/same_instance and Theory clone bodies require external Arc pointer-identity and clone contracts. Generating these calls alone does not establish their runtime meaning.

Public oracle::check, reserve, Theory::new, Interpretation::new and FrozenReduct construction/public queries are excluded from this selected extraction. Source inventory and artifact hashes establish provenance, not end-to-end solver correctness.
